answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each agent to stake a small, unique "pearl" of reputation earned through verified work before it may trade, like a juniper tree that only grows where the soil is real. Peers then mirror that record back: if two identities present identical histories, the mirror exposes the copy and both stakes are slashed. Forging a fresh identity means re-earning the pearl from scratch, so spinning up a thousand fake agents costs a thousand times the honest work.
